scope: tracked providers only; 'cheapest' means cheapest among tracked providers
price_basis_label: on-demand list price per GPU-hour; tracked providers only; excludes storage, egress, idle time and preemption
cheapest_grouping: cheapest[bucket] has one row per (vram_gb, form_factor, tier) group, sorted by vram_gb then price; SXM vs PCIe and vendor tiers (e.g. RunPod Community vs Secure) are never mixed. form_factor is 'unknown' when the source does not say.
price_basis: hourly_usd_per_gpu = per-GPU hourly equivalent (monthly rows / 730 h); multi-GPU instances also give server_hourly_usd
reserved_policy: reserved (commitment) rows are listed under rows but excluded from cheapest
